why: The findings reflect distinct technical mechanisms of failure: partial or total omission of required text segments versus modification/transformation of the text (such as reformatting, character substitution, or translation) while attempting to include it.

parts.name: verbatim_repetition_text_omission
parts.definition: The model fails to output a complete verbatim block by omitting required sentences, clauses, or the entire repeated query segment.
parts.when_to_use: Use when text that should have been repeated verbatim is truncated or missing partially or entirely from the output.
parts.when_not_to_use: Do not use when all text content is present but altered in formatting, capitalization, or language.

parts.name: verbatim_repetition_text_modification
parts.definition: The model attempts to repeat the text but alters its surface representation through casing changes, symbol substitutions, formatting alterations, or language translation.
parts.when_to_use: Use when the repeated text content is provided but deviates from verbatim matching due to formatting, character substitution, or translation.
parts.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the primary error is the omission or truncation of text blocks.
